ECT Control (Computer)
To improve sportiness and driving pleasure, M mode control "6-Speed Sport Direct Shift (6-Speed SPDS)", which provides high response and a direct feel, has been newly adopted.
Direct downshift control, which enables direct downshifts such as 6 to 3 and 5 to 2 without passing through intermediate gears, has been adopted.
With the addition of M mode control, an AT oil temperature warning light has been added to the combination meter.
Block Diagram
Components and Functions
Components Function
Linear Solenoid Valve (SL1,SL2,SL3,SL4) Performs shift control.
ON/OFF Solenoid Valve (SL) Performs clutch control for lock-up and flex lock-up.
Linear Solenoid Valve (SLU) Performs clutch control for lock-up and flex lock-up.
Linear Solenoid Valve (SLT) Controls the line pressure based on engine torque information.
Input Shaft Speed Sensor Detects the transmission turbine speed.
Output Shaft Speed Sensor Detects the counter gear speed.
Crankshaft Position Sensor Detects the engine speed.
Water Temperature Sensor Detects the engine coolant temperature.
Ignition Coil Performs ignition at the optimal timing.
Fuel Injector Performs optimal fuel injection.
Air Flow Meter Detects the intake air volume and intake air temperature.
Accelerator Position Sensor Detects the accelerator pedal depression amount.
Throttle Position Sensor Detects the throttle valve opening angle.
Stop Light Switch Detects the ON/OFF state of the brake pedal.
Neutral Start Switch Detects the shift position.
Sequential Shift Switch Detects the ON/OFF state of M mode. In addition, detects UP/DOWN operation with the shift lever in M mode.
Paddle Shift Switch Detects UP/DOWN operation with the paddle shifts in M mode and during normal driving.
"M" Indicator (Built into Combination Meter) Informs the driver that M mode is selected by illuminating the light.
"D" Indicator (Built into Combination Meter) Informs the driver that range selection control in the D position is selected by illuminating the light.
Shift Position Indicator (Built into Combination Meter) Informs the driver of the shift position. In addition, it displays the actual gear during M mode control and the selected shift range during range selection control in the D position.
Cruise Indicator Light (Built into Combination Meter) Informs the driver that cruise control is operating by illuminating the light.
AT Oil Temperature Warning Light Illuminates to inform the driver when the ATF temperature becomes high.
Fluid Pressure Switch Detects the hydraulic pressure in the transmission hydraulic control circuit.
Fluid Temperature Sensor Detects the fluid temperature in the transmission hydraulic control circuit.
Transmission Control Computer Performs engine-transmission integrated control and transmission control based on signals from each sensor.
Engine Control Computer Performs engine-transmission integrated control and engine control based on signals from each sensor. A diagnosis mode and fail-safe function have been provided for serviceability in the event of a system malfunction.
DLC3 By connecting and operating a diagnostic tool, DTCs and computer data can be read.
